His struggle, marked by guilt, is seen as an essential part of his character shaping and development. LiHua appears to enjoy the narrative complexities that this quest introduces, understanding that the man's internal conflicts mirror real-life introspections about purpose and identity.

The "Man in Black" thus becomes a critical figure through which fans can engage with philosophical and existential inquiries.

She recognizes the relevance of the show's exploration of consciousness, free will, and the human condition, and considers how these themes resonate with contemporary societal issues, particularly the ethical implications of technological advancements.

The importance of such thematic discussions is reflected in LiHua's reflections on another show character, in this case, Micah Bell from Read Dead Redemption 2, revealing her proclivity for analyzing intricate character motivations and moral dilemmas.
